messages:
Maria: FYI auditor emailed this morning asking for KMS/HSM rotation evidence + 12mo audit-log exports for SOC2 scope. Copying @Alyssa for controls, @Bennett for infra. Email thread: https://redwood.example.com/auditor-requests/REQ-2026-042

Alyssa: On it. Quick Q: admin audit logs are 365d, API request logs are 90d currently, right?

Bennett: Correct re: API logs (90d). KMS rotations are automated quarterly via cloud KMS. Last rotation recorded 2025-10-11. HSM rotation manifests in s3://redwood-compliance/hsm-rotation/ -- I can export.

Sara (Auditor): Clarify please: we need signed rotation manifests for each key, chain-of-custody for manual rotations, and 12 months of relevant audit logs or compensating controls.

Alyssa: We store signed manifests for customer-managed keys in the compliance vault. Service-managed keys have rotation manifests generated by the rotation job; pulling now.

SecurityBot: Started export job: /compliance/exports/REQ-2026-042/ (job id: e8a3f). ETA ~30m.

Bennett: CLI snippets I'm running for export:

```
# export KMS key metadata
gcloud kms keys describe KEY --project=prod-keys --format=json > /tmp/key-metadata.json
# copy HSM rotation manifests
gsutil cp gs://redwood-compliance/hsm-rotation/2025-10-11-manifest.json /tmp/
```

Alyssa: Auditor asked specifically for API request logs for the last 12 months tied to admin changes. We normally keep API logs 90d for cost reasons. Can we backfill 12mo?

Evan: We have cold backups (long-term snapshots) that go to cold storage for 18mo. We can extract the 12mo slice but need legal/privacy approval before handing over anything with PII. Retention policy: https://redwood.example.com/docs/data-retention

Maria: @Noah (Legal) can you approve a redacted export for the auditor? They requested delivery by EOD Friday (3 days).

Noah (Legal): Approved for redacted exports to external auditors. Use presigned links with 7-day expiry and ensure PII redaction prior to export. Record approval in the evidence tracker.

Alyssa: Plan/ETA: 1) KMS rotation manifests (s3 link) 2) HSM rotation logs (s3 link) 3) Admin audit log export (gcs link) 4) API request redacted export (s3/gs) — full package in ~48 hours.

Sara (Auditor): 48 hours is acceptable. Also include Change Control evidence (RFCs/jira tickets) showing approvals for rotations.

Bennett: Adding ticket refs: INFRA-4472, SEC-1321. Will include in package.

SecurityBot: Export complete: /compliance/exports/REQ-2026-042/package-2026-03-15.tar.gz (signed). checksum: abc123def456. Secure link: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/exports/REQ-2026-042/package-2026-03-15.tar.gz?sig=redacted-token

Alyssa: Uploaded to secure share and emailed secure inbox to auditor. @Noah please confirm ACLs & expiry.

Noah (Legal): ACLs set, presigned link expiry = 7 days. Evidence tracked as EV-2026-078 in the compliance tracker.

Sara (Auditor): Received package. One follow-up: rotation manifests show dates but not approver identity. Can you include JIRA approvals or signed email approvals?

Maria: We have JIRA approvals and archived approval emails. Adding PDFs to the package now (SEC-1321 attachments).

Alyssa: PDFs attached to the evidence package and to the EV-2026-078 record. Auditor, let us know if anything else is missing.

Sara (Auditor): Looks good for initial review. Marking control as 'in review'. Will report any gaps after reviewing docs.

Bennett: Action item: re-evaluate API log retention for SOC2 scope — consider increasing to 12 months or ensure archiving/backfill flow.

Maria: Created task SECOPS-204 to analyze cost/impact and propose retention changes.

Alyssa: Closing loop: evidence delivered, EV-2026-078 filed, auditor notified. Thanks everyone.
